account.adminManages: A billing administrator can manage this account.
account.useManageBilling: Use Manage billing to update your subscription or payment details.
account.confirmationNote: Access and credits update after payment confirmation. Returning from checkout alone does not activate a plan.
account.renewalCredits: {credits} credits per paid renewal; unused renewal credits expire at period end.
account.unavailable: Billing details are not available yet.

history.unpaidNote: Invoices and transactions include unpaid records. Their totals do not confirm payment.

topUp.processing: Your payment of {amount} is being processed. The credits arrive when it clears.
topUp.failed: The payment of {amount} failed. Nothing was added.
topUp.expired: The payment page for {amount} expired. Nothing was added.
